definitions.explanation: An enclosure or shelter for keeping birds. Can range from a small outdoor birdhouse to a chicken coop to a larger aviary at a zoo or park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鳥小屋|とりごや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I built a birdhouse in the garden.

examples.japanese: {鳥小屋|とりごや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I clean the birdcage every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動物園|どうぶつえん}→動物園：01686_doubutsuen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鳥小屋|とりごや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{色|いろ}とりどり→色とりどり：10404_irotoridori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧がいた。
examples.english: The aviary at the zoo had birds of many colors.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧ (bird) + ⟦{小屋|こや}→小屋：02768_koya⟧ (shed, hut, small building). The word covers various sizes of bird enclosures. In rural settings, it often refers specifically to a {鶏小屋|にわとりごや} (chicken coop). The ⟦{小屋|こや}→小屋：02768_koya⟧ component undergoes rendaku, becoming ごや.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鳥小屋|とりごや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to build a birdhouse
- {鳥小屋|とりごや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧: cleaning the birdcage/coop
- {鳥小屋|とりごや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧: to keep in a birdcage

RELATED WORDS:
- {鶏小屋|にわとりごや}: chicken coop (specifically for chickens)
- {犬小屋|いぬごや}: doghouse
- ⟦{小屋|こや}→小屋：02768_koya⟧: hut, shed (base word)
- ⟦{巣箱|すばこ}→巣箱：26028_subako⟧: nesting box, birdhouse (specifically for nesting)
